einzeiler: 49ers face new injuries ahead of the season opener in Australia against the Rams.
kurzfassung: The San Francisco 49ers deal with a fresh wave of injuries as Sam Okuayinonu lands on IR and the team signs Khalid Kareem. Ahead of the week one matchup in Australia against the Los Angeles Rams, analysts discuss the status of Nick Bosa and Aaron Donald. Additionally, Keon White shares his unique perspective on recovering from a gunshot wound.
stichpunkte: Sam Okuayinonu is placed on IR, missing the season opener in Australia.
The 49ers sign defensive lineman Khalid Kareem to bolster depth.
Nick Bosa's health and readiness remain a major talking point for week one.
Analysts evaluate how Osa Digizua helps anchor the defensive front.
Aaron Donald's status for the Rams remains questionable heading into the matchup.
Keon White discusses his recovery process after suffering a gunshot wound to the foot.
Trade rumors circulate regarding the Dallas Cowboys targeting Max Crosby.

clips.hook: Losing depth right before week one!
clips.text: The hosts break down the immediate impact of losing Sam Okuayinonu to the injured reserve and how it stretches an already thin defensive rotation.
The discussion turns to devising specific blocking schemes to neutralize Aaron Donald's explosive first step in the interior.
The panel compares the vastly improved current receiving corps to the struggling roster options from the previous season.

clips.hook: Football players don't just get shot every day!
clips.text: Keon White provides a remarkably blunt assessment of dealing with a traumatic injury compared to standard football protocol.

clips.hook: Hands off those first round picks!
clips.text: The hosts strongly advise against trading future first-round draft picks, highlighting the exceptional talent expected in upcoming classes.

beschreibung:
The San Francisco 49ers got some unfortunate news about a key piece of their defensive front, as Sam Okuayinonu landed on the IR and did not make the trip to Australia ahead of the team's week one matchup against the Los Angeles Rams. To fill his roster spot, the San Francisco 49ers signed Khalid Kareem off the Atlanta Falcons' practice squad, a player who has familiarity with the Raheem Morris defensive scheme. We inch ever closer to the start of the regular season, less than a week away.
